headline: Bring your EV telemetry into view
intro: Connect A Better Routeplanner to Home Assistant and follow the vehicle data it reports. Streamed readings can surface as sensors for state of charge, range, charging state, power, and battery details, giving you a live view of your EV at home.
highlights: Track state of charge, range, and charging state for each connected vehicle
See reported readings such as power, voltage, battery temperature, capacity, and odometer
Sensor entities appear when a vehicle reports that metric; available readings vary by vehicle and connectivity

flow.title: From ABRP account to vehicle readings
